title: Vault Limbo
description: Mini game with vault in minecraft
body:
**Vault Limbo** turns every Trial Chamber vault into a mini-game inspired by the
  famous key-shuffle section of the Geometry Dash level **LIMBO**.

  When you open a vault with its key, the loot isn't handed over right away. Instead,
  **8 keys appear floating in front of the vault** and shuffle around — and you have to
  keep your eye on the right one.

  ## How it works

  1. Right-click a vault with its key (a normal **Trial Key** for a normal vault, an
     **Ominous Trial Key** for an ominous one). Your key is consumed — one attempt.
  2. The keys line up in a **4×2 grid**. The correct key briefly **flashes / grows**, so
     memorize its position.
  3. The keys then **shuffle through 26 consecutive moves**, recreating the real LIMBO
     patterns: 2×2 block rotations, column swaps, X-diagonal swaps, O-shape rotations,
     top/bottom exchanges and more. The keys slide between cells and their paths cross,
     so you really have to track yours.
  4. When the keys settle, **click the key you were following**, right there in the world.
  5. **Right key → you get the vault's own loot** (fully vanilla — normal or ominous).
     **Wrong key → nothing, and your key is spent.**

  ## Features

  - Works on **both normal and ominous vaults**, dropping their real vanilla loot.
  - Faithful recreation of the **LIMBO shuffle patterns and paths**.
  - **5 speed presets** and an in-game config screen via **Mod Menu** (bundled — no extra
    download needed): shuffle speed, reveal time, grid size, height and offset.
  - Server-authoritative: the outcome is decided on the server, so it's safe in multiplayer.
